## What it is about

An editorial in the *Revista Española de Sociología* that asks whether we should accept AI reviewing the articles submitted to a journal. It defines and characterises generative AI, reviews tools that already assist research and sets out four possible scenarios: democratisation of research, underuse of AI, rising inequality and digital laggards.

The central argument: AI greatly expands what a researcher can do, but it cannot "hit the streets". It cannot replace fieldwork or the interpretation of social context. The text closes with concrete proposals: training in AI tools, research-based education and an open debate on the use of AI in managing scientific journals.
